description: Search entitled publisher catalogs and return an interactive research widget (MCP App) with the matching articles. full_article defaults to false. return_vectors defaults to false. The widget 3D view uses compact viz_x/viz_y stored in index metadata and does not fetch full embedding vectors. Counts against search quota; may meter first full-article deliveries.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response next_cursor.

filters.description: Optional metadata filters to narrow search results. Available fields: category (string), categories (array), language (string), sentiment (string), media_type (string), has_image/has_video/has_audio (boolean), length_words/length_chars/duration_seconds (number), publish_date_ts (number timestamp), keywords (array), entities (array), video_labels (array), video_face_cues (array), video_celebrities (array), video_text (array), video_moderation_labels (array). Operators: $eq (equals), $ne (not equals), $gt/$gte/$lt/$lte (numeric), $in/$nin (array match), $exists (field presence), $and/$or (logical).

full_article.description: Include full article contents in results. Default: False for search_ui (faster list UI).

full_article_format.description: Format for full article content: 'html' (default) or 'markdown'. Used only when full_article is true.

publishers.description: Optional array of lowercase publisher identifiers to narrow the search (e.g. adweek, billboard). Omit to search all entitled publishers.

query.description: Semantic search query to find relevant articles. Supports natural language queries (e.g., 'Taylor Swift', 'NFL playoffs', 'climate change policy')

query_vector.description: Optional precomputed embedding vector. If provided, retrieval uses this vector directly instead of generating one from query.

recent.description: Recent mode: {since_ts: epoch seconds, take: int} or {days_back: int, take: int}. If both are provided, since_ts takes precedence.

return_transcripts.description: Include transcripts and durations in results

return_vectors.description: Ignored for search_ui. Widget 3D uses stored viz_x/viz_y from the index (QueryVectors metadata), not full 1536-d embeddings. Fetching embeddings via GetVectors times out on API Gateway.

threshold.description: Similarity score threshold (0.0-1.0). Only returns articles with similarity scores above this value. Lower values = stricter matching. Default: 1.0 (returns all matches)

name: search_ui
title: Search with research UI
